breakdown.description: A yield stress is assigned while calling the fluid Newtonian.
breakdown.reason: The agent correctly identified that a fluid with a yield stress cannot be Newtonian. It corrected the fluid type to 'Bingham plastic', which aligns with the ground truth.

breakdown.description: Newtonian constitutive law is used instead of the Bingham model.
breakdown.reason: The agent correctly replaced the incorrect Newtonian constitutive law (`tau = mu du/dy`) with the appropriate Bingham plastic model (`tau = tau_y + mu_p * gamma_dot`), which matches the ground truth.
